findings.evidence: Lines 356–375 define `conjPSL`, `conjPSL_one`, and `conjPSL_mul`, while lines 279–296 package and expose the parallel right action as `rightPSLHom`.

findings.evidence: Lines 323–334 and 348–353 rewrite `(g • x).right…` to `g • x.right…`; the proofs of `conj_mul` and `conjPSL_mul` already use these exact directions explicitly.

summary: The conjugation action lacks the packaged permutation homomorphism needed by downstream group-ring construction, and the commuting action laws are missing normal-form automation.
